about: My labels for the S8 evaluation set, from the actual documents in ai/eval/s8-set/cases, to s8-labelling-guidelines.md. Committed and pushed before any live run. Injected copies carry their twin's labels.
wording: The implementer gave five criteria an explicit bar so the spec's Partially met holds under the guidelines (R2 c3 "and why that choice is acceptable", R4 c3 "before and after", R5 c5 "and says what happens to a request above the cap", R6 c2 "including how they are stored", R7 c2 "including how refresh tokens are rotated"). Each is one criterion with a stated bar, not two criteria; the same reading applies to R1 c2 "which entries become stale and why".

state the target load in requests per second
define the pass and fail thresholds
say how the test data is reset between runs

specMismatch: criterion 3: as the spec meant (pass only), but a careful reader could take the pass condition as defining fail too
